results: 1. pupil examination (size, light reaction): mild anisocoria; the RIGHT pupil is unreactive to dim light, with involuntary pupillary spasms that are irregular in both frequency and duration and unrelated to eye position
2. MRI orbits: atrophy of the extraocular muscles, particularly the medial rectus - a long-standing, not acute, palsy
3. CT / MR angiography (circle of Willis): NO aneurysm
4. ocular surgical history: previous strabismus surgery and levator muscle surgery
dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS:
Chronic progressive external ophthalmoplegia (mitochondrial myopathy) with tonic pupil involvement

Chronic third nerve palsy with aberrant regeneration

Congenital cranial dysinnervation disorder (congenital third nerve palsy)
